tools.name: search_products
tools.description: Search the public catalog of launched products in plain language (min 2 characters).

tools.name: get_product
tools.description: The full public listing for one product, by slug or key.

tools.name: check_launch_readiness
tools.description: Audit a URL before adding it to krawlup: bans, blocked platforms, whether the product already exists (and who owns it), plus the optional category list. Run this before add_product.

tools.name: get_site_report
tools.description: The free public site report for any website (the /site-report tool): performance, AEO, CRO, SEO crawl, CrUX, OpenPageRank, scorecards and the named checks behind them — the same data the public site-report page renders. Cached read, never generates; if hasReport is false, call run_site_report and po

tools.name: run_site_report
tools.description: Start the free public scan for any website and return immediately. Authenticated agents get 2 full scans per calendar month per credential; anonymous callers share a per-IP monthly budget with every other surface. Poll get_site_report for the domain until scanStage clears to read the finished report

tools.name: list_products
tools.description: List your products on krawlup with their latest scan scores

tools.name: get_my_products_status
tools.description: Your products with their directory visibility (public/private) — most recent first.

tools.name: compare_products
tools.description: All your products side by side — lifetime or windowed (today / 7d / 30d / 90d) unique visitors, views, revenue totals with refunds netted, average revenue per conversion, revenue per visitor, and scan scores, sorted by any of them. Windowed numbers are computed exactly the way the dashboard computes

tools.name: get_my_subscription
tools.description: The founder's current subscription: plan name and price, status (active / trial / in the 3-day renewal grace / expired read-only), the plan's abilities and limits (a limit of 0 means unlimited), usage against this period's meters, and a can-do summary. Call this FIRST to check which features the fou

tools.name: add_product
tools.description: Add a product from just its URL: krawlup scrapes the site (name, tagline, description, icons) and adds it to the founder's dashboard. Every other field is optional — explicit values override the scrape. Adding NEVER publishes — the product is private until the founder (or set_product_public) publish

tools.name: set_product_public
tools.description: Make one of your products public in the krawlup directory. Publishing requires an active paid subscription (no trial) OR an admin-approved publishing grant covering this exact product; the 403 message names which. Unpublishing is set_product_private. Requires the submit permission.

tools.name: set_product_private
tools.description: Remove one of your products from the public directory (always allowed, any plan).

tools.name: get_insights
tools.description: Full latest insights for one product — everything the dashboard renders: overall + per-plane scorecards, failing audits, Core Web Vitals metrics, conversion (CRO) checks, the mobile layout test, AI-readiness facts (llms.txt, AI-crawler robots, structured data), trust/security checks, CrUX field data

tools.name: get_fix_cards
tools.description: All stored AI fix cards for one product (what/why/steps/agent prompt per issue). Requires a plan with the ai_fix_cards facility

tools.name: get_scan_history
tools.description: Score-over-time series for one product (last 100 scans, chronological): performance, AEO, CRO, SEO crawl, scorecards, CrUX, openRank, and issue counts — plus per-run source and timestamp

tools.name: get_analytics_snippet
tools.description: The exact <script> tag that installs krawlup first-party analytics on a product's own website (visitors, sessions, pages, referrers, countries, conversion goals). The returned snippet already embeds the site token at data-site="…" — insert BOTH lines yourself; never ask the founder to paste the toke

tools.name: get_analytics_token
tools.description: The raw analytics site token for one product — the data-site value inside the krawlup analytics tag. The token is not a secret (it travels in the tagged page source by design) and is already embedded inside the snippet returned by get_analytics_snippet — never ask the founder to paste the token. Use

tools.name: set_excluded_pages
tools.description: Replace the per-product Excluded pages board — paths whose visits are discarded at intake (never stored, never counted). DESTRUCTIVE: it changes what the site's analytics records. MCP clients should prompt the site owner before calling; regardless, set confirm=true ONLY after the owner explicitly ap

tools.name: get_website_analytics
tools.description: First-party website analytics for one product: visitors, sessions, bounce, session duration, pages per session, pageviews, daily series, entry/exit pages, top pages/referrers, acquisition channels, UTM sources, countries/devices, AI crawler visits (AI answers / indexing / training, with a partial fl

tools.name: get_bottleneck
tools.description: The stored AI bottleneck analysis for one product (THE one edit to make, with why/impact/steps and the agent prompt), or null if not run yet

tools.name: get_keyword_ideas
tools.description: The stored keyword research for one product: intent-clustered keyword ideas with volume/difficulty estimates (exact volume + CPC when a Keywords Everywhere key is configured), prioritized content actions, and a per-keyword verdict (own/push/hard/skip). A new run can be triggered from here with run_k

tools.name: run_keyword_research
tools.description: Runs one keyword research for a product: a Google-autocomplete sweep clustered by a model into intent groups with volume/difficulty estimates and prioritized content actions (Jev-scored fit/demand/competition when the TypeSafe key is bound). Spends one of the founder's monthly keyword-research runs

tools.name: add_tracked_keywords
tools.description: Adds keywords to a product's rank-tracking board (max KEYWORD_TRACK_CAP per product). Tracked keywords are re-checked by the scanner on its scan passes and their top-10 positions become the rank history get_keyword_ranks reads. Requires a key with the rescan scope

tools.name: remove_tracked_keywords
tools.description: Removes keywords from a product's rank-tracking board. Their stored rank-check history is deleted with them. Requires a key with the rescan scope

tools.name: get_keyword_ranks
tools.description: Rank history for a product's tracked keywords, as checked by the scanner on its scan passes: per keyword the latest position (null = checked and not in the top-10), best position, and the series of stored checks. Only positions actually checked are returned — never interpolated. searchConfigured=fal

tools.name: trigger_rescan
tools.description: Starts a fresh full analysis of one product in the background — spends one of the founder's full-analysis allowances for the current billing period (per product, and across all their products), plus one page speed check. Returns immediately; poll get_insights for this product until scanPending is fa

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: check_launch_readiness, add_product, get_fix_cards, get_scan_history · Private data: run_site_report, get_my_products_status, add_product, set_product_private, get_analytics_snippet, get_analytics_token, set_excluded_pages · Public sink: run_site_report, add_product, set_product_public, set_excluded_pages · Destructive: check_launch_readiness, run_site_report, set_product_private, get_scan_history, get_bottleneck, get_keyword_ideas, run_keyword_research, remove_tracked_keywords.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: check_launch_readiness, add_product, get_fix_cards, get_scan_history · Private data: run_site_report, get_my_products_status, add_product, set_product_private, get_analytics_snippet, get_analytics_token, set_excluded_pages · Public sink: run_site_report, add_product, set_product_public, set_excluded_pages · Destructive: check_launch_readiness, run_site_report, set_product_private, get_scan_history, get_bottleneck, get_keyword_ideas, run_keyword_research, remove_tracked_keywords

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
